primary_readout: Equal mean of three layer log probabilities; per-layer results diagnostic only
preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on 2159 host fitting rows only; same fit/validation rows for all five backbones
promotion: An adapted primary readout must beat the identical base readout by >=0.01 and reach >=0.4044444444 before broader confirmation. No pilot submission.
limitations: Final host adapters are valid only on v18's held-out fold; their training rows must never be used as OOF evidence
External-only adapters can support later folds, but v18's global host-text overlap exclusion is retained
This tests readout quality, not new backbone training
